backup_odb_subnet.rationale: backup_odb_subnet is a reference to which subnet backs up this resource, an architectural choice rather than a control itself.

deletion_policy.description:
Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance. Defaults to "DELETE".
When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the instance,
the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.
deletion_policy.rationale: If deletion_policy is left at its default (DELETE), this resource can be destroyed accidentally via terraform destroy or apply, risking loss of an active database cluster and its data.

deletion_protection.description: Whether or not to allow Terraform to destroy the instance. Unless this field is set to false in Terraform state, a terraform destroy or terraform apply that would delete the instance will fail.
deletion_protection.rationale: This is a second, independent deletion-blocking flag on this resource. Unless explicitly set to false, it prevents terraform destroy or apply from removing the instance, leaving it at its default protects against accidental data loss.

display_name.description:
The display name for the ExadbVmCluster. The name does not have to
be unique within your project. The name must be 1-255 characters long and
can only contain alphanumeric characters.
display_name.rationale: display_name is a free-text label field with no functional effect on resource behaviour, so it carries no security impact.

exadb_vm_cluster_id.description:
The ID of the ExadbVmCluster to create. This value is
restricted to (^[a-z]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$) and must be a maximum of
63 characters in length. The value must start with a letter and end with a
letter or a number.
exadb_vm_cluster_id.rationale: exadb_vm_cluster_id is a resource identifier constrained by naming convention, not a control affecting access, exposure, or data protection.

labels.description:
The labels or tags associated with the ExadbVmCluster.

**Note**: This field is non-authoritative, and will only manage the labels present in your configuration.
Please refer to the field 'effective_labels' for all of the labels present on the resource.
labels.rationale: labels is non-authoritative organizational metadata with no functional effect on resource behaviour.

location.description: Resource ID segment making up resource 'name'. It identifies the resource within its parent collection as described in https://google.aip.dev/122.
location.rationale: Determines the region/zone where the resource is created. Policy should restrict it to an approved-region whitelist for data residency; the allowed set is parameterised (a hardcoded example whitelist is acceptable).

odb_network.description:
The name of the OdbNetwork associated with the ExadbVmCluster.
Format: projects/{project}/locations/{location}/odbNetworks/{odb_network}
It is optional but if specified, this should match the parent ODBNetwork of
the OdbSubnet.
odb_network.rationale: odb_network is a reference to which network this cluster attaches to, an architectural choice rather than a control itself.

odb_subnet.rationale: odb_subnet is a reference to the subnet used for IP allocation, an architectural choice rather than a control itself, consistent with backup_odb_subnet and odb_network.

project.description: The ID of the project in which the resource belongs. If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: project is an identifier/reference to the parent project, not a control itself.

properties.additional_ecpu_count_per_nod.description:
The number of additional ECPUs per node for an Exadata VM cluster on
exascale infrastructure.
properties.additional_ecpu_count_per_nod.rationale: additional_ecpu_count_per_node is a compute capacity sizing value, not a control affecting access, exposure, or data protection.

properties.cluster_name.description:
The cluster name for Exascale vm cluster. The cluster name must begin with
an alphabetic character and may contain hyphens(-) but can not contain
underscores(_). It should be not more than 11 characters and is not case
sensitive.
OCI Cluster name.
properties.cluster_name.rationale: properties.cluster_name is an internal naming value constrained by naming convention, not a control affecting access, exposure, or data protection.

properties.enabled_ecpu_count_per_node.description:
The number of ECPUs enabled per node for an exadata vm cluster on
exascale infrastructure.
properties.enabled_ecpu_count_per_node.rationale: enabled_ecpu_count_per_node is a compute capacity sizing value, not a control affecting access, exposure, or data protection.

properties.exascale_db_storage_vault.description:
The name of ExascaleDbStorageVault associated with the ExadbVmCluster.
It can refer to an existing ExascaleDbStorageVault. Or a new one can be
created during the ExadbVmCluster creation (requires
storage_vault_properties to be set).
Format:
projects/{project}/locations/{location}/exascaleDbStorageVaults/{exascale_db_storage_vault}
properties.exascale_db_storage_vault.rationale: exascale_db_storage_vault is a reference/identifier to the storage vault resource, an architectural choice rather than a control itself.

properties.grid_image_id.rationale: grid_image_id selects the Grid Infrastructure version; a version-choice field with no single universally unsafe value for a platform policy to block.

properties.hostname_prefix.description: Prefix for VM cluster host names.
properties.hostname_prefix.rationale: hostname_prefix is a naming convention value with no functional effect on access, exposure, or data protection.

properties.license_model.description:
The license type of the ExadbVmCluster.
Possible values:
LICENSE_INCLUDED
BRING_YOUR_OWN_LICENSE
properties.license_model.rationale: license_model is a licensing/billing choice between LICENSE_INCLUDED and BRING_YOUR_OWN_LICENSE, not a security control.

properties.node_count.description: The number of nodes/VMs in the ExadbVmCluster.
properties.node_count.rationale: node_count is a capacity sizing value, not a control affecting access, exposure, or data protection.

properties.scan_listener_port_tcp.rationale: scan_listener_port_tcp is a port configuration value; no single value is inherently unsafe for a generic platform policy to block.

properties.shape_attribute.description:
The shape attribute of the VM cluster. The type of Exascale storage used
for Exadata VM cluster. The default is SMART_STORAGE which supports Oracle
Database 23ai and later
Possible values:
SMART_STORAGE
BLOCK_STORAGE
properties.shape_attribute.rationale: shape_attribute is a hardware/storage shape choice, an architectural decision rather than a control itself.

properties.ssh_public_keys.description: The SSH public keys for the ExadbVmCluster.
properties.ssh_public_keys.rationale: SSH public keys directly control who can authenticate to the VM cluster, this is a direct access-control mechanism, not merely configuration.

properties.data_collection_options.is_di.description: Indicates whether to enable data collection for diagnostics.
properties.data_collection_options.is_di.rationale: Disabling diagnostic event collection reduces visibility into anomalous or malicious activity, weakening incident detection and response capability.

properties.data_collection_options.is_he.description: Indicates whether to enable health monitoring.
properties.data_collection_options.is_he.rationale: is_health_monitoring_enabled controls operational/availability health monitoring, not an audit or access-control mechanism.

properties.data_collection_options.is_in.description: Indicates whether to enable incident logs and trace collection.
properties.data_collection_options.is_in.rationale: Disabling incident logs and trace collection directly removes the audit trail needed for security incident investigation and forensics.

properties.time_zone.description:
Represents a time zone from the
[IANA Time Zone Database](https://www.iana.org/time-zones).

properties.time_zone.id.description: IANA Time Zone Database time zone. For example "America/New_York".
properties.time_zone.id.rationale: time_zone.id is an operational configuration value with no functional effect on access, exposure, or data protection.

properties.time_zone.version.description: IANA Time Zone Database version number. For example "2019a".
properties.time_zone.version.rationale: time_zone.version is an operational configuration value with no functional effect on access, exposure, or data protection.

properties.vm_file_system_storage.description: The storage allocation for the exadbvmcluster, in gigabytes (GB).

properties.vm_file_system_storage.size_i.description:
The storage allocation for the exadbvmcluster per node, in gigabytes (GB).
This field is used to calculate the total storage allocation for the
exadbvmcluster.
properties.vm_file_system_storage.size_i.rationale: size_in_gbs_per_node is a storage capacity sizing value, not a control affecting access, exposure, or data protection.
